content: LoadedWarrenConfig.sourceFile (warren-489c / #486) reports the relative path the global defaults were loaded from: .warren/config.yaml when present, else .warren/defaults.json (legacy) when only it exists, else null. Computed by resolveDefaultsSourceFile in src/warren-config/load.ts (pure existence check mirroring loadDefaults precedence) so a malformed file still reports its source path. Threaded into the GET /projects/:id/warren-config response in src/server/handlers/projects.ts for the UI to render a dynamic config-source label instead of a hardcoded one.
